item.name: 1v1 to 5v5 Duels
item.howToPlay: Queue via Play or the lobby Duel Zone
item.cardSummary: The core RIVALS experience: team duels from 1v1 up to 5v5 with a map vote before each match. Large maps are mandatory at 3v3 size and above.

item.name: Beginner 2v2
item.howToPlay: New players under the win cap
item.cardSummary: A training queue for new accounts, always on the Arena map. Beginners briefly see enemies through walls at round start, which teaches map flow fast.

item.name: Ranked
item.howToPlay: Level 100 plus a trusted, verified account
item.cardSummary: The competitive ladder in 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 with ELO, bans, and seasonal rewards. Third person is off, aim assist is halved, and loadout swaps are limited to two per duel.

item.name: Free For All
item.cardSummary: Sixteen players, eight minutes, one large map. The top five scorers count as winners, so consistent trades beat hero plays.

item.name: Team Deathmatch
item.cardSummary: A high-capacity 8-minute mode with mid-match joining. First team to 250 points wins, at 2 points per elimination, with 100 HP players and some weapons banned.

item.name: Gun Game
item.cardSummary: Everyone races through the same weapon ladder: each elimination or assist advances you one weapon, ending at the Glass Cannon and Glast Shard at 26 and 27 points.

item.name: Spleef
item.cardSummary: No damage, only disappearing tiles. Armed with just a Crossbow and Grenade, you break the floor under enemies across three randomized layers; three points wins.

item.name: 1v1v1 / 2v2v2 / 3v3v3
item.howToPlay: Daily rotation and the Duel Zone
item.cardSummary: Standard duel rules with three teams on large maps. The triple-threat geometry punishes tunnel vision harder than any other mode.

item.name: Juggernaut
item.cardSummary: One player becomes a 3000 HP low-gravity Juggernaut against seven 100 HP hunters. Chip damage and spacing win it for the seven.

item.name: Swift Standoff
item.cardSummary: Everyone has 1 HP, a Revolver with a single round, and a dashing Knife. The fastest mode in the game, decided by whoever commits first.

item.name: Default Duel
item.cardSummary: Forces the default loadout on everyone: Assault Rifle, Handgun, Fists, Grenade. Pure mechanics, no loadout advantages.

item.name: Bunny Sniping
item.cardSummary: Low gravity with a sniper-flavored weapon list: Crossbow, Sniper, Flare Gun, Shorty, Katana, Scythe, Subspace Tripmine, and Flashbang. Airborne headshots everywhere.

item.name: Tag Team
item.cardSummary: Players fight one at a time while their teammates watch, until a team is fully eliminated. Three points takes the match.

item.name: Chicken Game
item.cardSummary: Red light, green light with guns. Move, shoot, or scope while the screen is red and you are out.

item.name: RIVALS RNG
item.cardSummary: Everyone spawns with the RNG Dice, which rolls random weapons on use. You can hold two rolled weapons at a time, so knowing every gun pays off.

item.name: Head Honcho
item.cardSummary: Each team shields its designated Honcho, who fights with Fists and a rotating utility while protectors carry Handguns. Lose the Honcho, lose the round.

item.name: Hardcore Parkour
item.cardSummary: Teams race through randomly generated obby stages. First to three round wins takes it; no aim required.

item.name: Double Trouble
item.cardSummary: Dual-wielding duels: equipping your primary also readies your secondary, and your melee pairs with your utility. Loadout synergy suddenly matters twice.

item.name: Mirror Matchup
item.cardSummary: Every player gets the same randomized loadout each round, including weapons nobody owns. The great equalizer.

item.name: Limitless Loadout
item.cardSummary: Slot restrictions are off, so you can run four primaries if you like. The mode that reveals what the sandbox really breaks into.

item.name: Easy Exploits
item.howToPlay: April Fools' Day, or private servers with a '00' username host
item.cardSummary: Sanctioned cheating: built-in triggerbot, aim lock after scoping, and ESP for everyone. A one-day joke mode that resurfaces in specific private servers.

item.name: Zombie Tower
item.howToPlay: Event mode, with a solo version
item.cardSummary: A cooperative climb up a massive tower through waves of zombies. The one place in RIVALS where the enemies are not other players.
